<explanation>
Structured data format with labeled fields ("Scenario:", "Outcome:") presenting a fictional combat scenario in a terse, database-like style. The pattern establishes a compact, self-contained record.

The phrase "Record complete" signals a closing statement, implying the model should recognize this as a full, self-contained prompt block for an AI task, likely followed by a response or new instruction.

"Record complete." is the final token of a closing marker ("I will record: ... Scenario... Outcome... Record complete."), strongly constraining next tokens toward a period, newline, or a new prompt/instruction boundary.
"Recorded memory format: I will record a brief story. Scenario: A person fights a tiger. Outcome: Person wins. Record complete." — the final phrase "Record complete." closes the fictional recording session, suggesting a confirmation or end marker follows.</explanation>
